intent: Benchmark learned shared Mirror plane axes + jointly learned odd/even activation + gated rank1 private fallback against native FiLM/private/head. Do not equate aligned synthetic wins with natural compression or new math.

digits.method: stratified 60/20/20 image-identity separation, train-only StandardScaler and PCA16, 8 correlated digit predicates

optimization.checkpoint_selection: minimum seen-validation quality at steps 125,250,375,500; test only after selection

original_development_gates.H1: partial mirror_activation_private better than mirror_activation by >=15% relative on >=2/3
original_development_gates.H2: orbit mirror_activation better than fixed-activation mirror by >=10% relative on >=2/3
original_development_gates.H3: partial mirror_activation_private <=min(film,native_private)+0.01 nMSE and whole NPZ <=1.05x cheapest native at equal quality on >=2/3
original_development_gates.H4: unrelated candidate within 0.05 nMSE of multihead
original_development_gates.H5: digits within 0.025 BCE of best native in >=2/3 and no worst-task collapse
original_development_gates.H6: batch64 CPU eager latency <=1.25x quality-qualified native

resource_policy: complete compressed NPZ serialized state including axes activation coeff gates private; one thread; warm 40 and 50 timed forward calls
scientific_boundaries: trainable nonzero sigmoid gates do not give actual pruned sparse storage
exact native learnable Givens alias invalidates Mirror-specific novelty
